product_overview: OpenYuGi is a free Spanish-language web app for cataloguing physical Yu-Gi-Oh! cards. Users can create an account, sign in, and access a private card collection that starts empty for new accounts.
core_goals: Create a free account with a unique username and password
Sign in with existing account credentials
Access protected pages only when signed in
View a private collection that is isolated per account
Start a new account with an empty collection and a loaded card catalogue

features.name: Signup
features.description: A new user can create a free account and be signed into their private collection.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Choose to create an account -> Navigate to /registro -> Enter a valid username, password, and matching password confirmation -> Submit the registration form -> See the account created successfully -> Land on /collection signed in with the username shown in the top bar
Navigate to /registro -> Enter a username with invalid format -> Submit the registration form -> See the username validation error
Navigate to /registro -> Enter a password shorter than the minimum length -> Submit the registration form -> See the password length error
Navigate to /registro -> Enter a password and a different confirmation password -> Submit the registration form -> See the password mismatch error
Navigate to /registro -> Enter an already used username -> Submit the registration form -> See the username already exists error

features.name: Login
features.description: An existing user can sign in with a username and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter valid account credentials -> Submit the login form -> See the session start and the signed-in account state
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See the incorrect username or password message and remain on /login

features.name: Protected page access
features.description: Signed-out visitors are redirected away from private areas until they authenticate.
user_flows: Navigate to /collection while signed out -> See redirection to /login with a next destination
Navigate to / while signed out -> See redirection to /login with a next destination
Navigate to /decks while signed out -> See redirection to /login with a next destination
Navigate to /settings while signed out -> See redirection to /login with a next destination

features.name: Signed-in session persistence
features.description: A signed-in user stays authenticated when revisiting the collection page.
user_flows: Sign in successfully -> Navigate to /collection -> Reload the page -> See the same signed-in session remain active

features.name: Private empty collection after signup
features.description: A newly registered account opens a private collection with no existing cards and no catalogue loading error.
user_flows: Complete signup successfully -> Land on /collection -> View the empty personal collection -> See that no cards are present in the new account's collection -> Observe the card catalogue load without an error toast

tech_stack: NiceGUI 3.13 (server-rendered Vue/Quasar over a socket.io WebSocket)

routes.description: Landing page with the login form and a "Crear cuenta" button
Free signup form (Usuario, Contraseña, Repite la contraseña)
One-time token callback that sets the session and redirects
The signed-in account's card collection; landing page after signup

features.name: Signup
features.description: Anyone can create a free account; each account gets a private data folder
user_interactions: Fill Usuario, Contraseña and Repite la contraseña
See an inline error for an invalid username, short password, mismatched passwords or an existing username
Land on /collection signed in, with the username in the top bar

features.name: Login
features.description: Username and password login for the primary account and registered accounts
user_interactions: See "Usuario o contraseña incorrectos." on bad credentials

features.name: Route protection
features.description: Protected pages redirect to /login?next=... without a valid session
user_interactions: Open a protected page while signed out and get redirected to /login

features.name: Collection after signup
features.description: A new account sees an empty collection and the card catalogue loads without an error toast
user_interactions: View the empty collection in collector mode

known_limitations.issue: The first catalogue load downloads the YGOPRODeck card database and can take several seconds
known_limitations.impact: Collection pages may show a loading state for a while on a fresh instance
